description.en: The words of the stories Old Wilf tells by the fire in the evening: the Borrowdale cuckoo and the wall, the Bowder Stone on its edge, the Lady of the Lake and King Arthur's sword, Owain the giant king and the wild boars, and the hob who left for a new coat.
description.sl: Besede iz zgodb, ki jih stari Wilf zvečer pripoveduje ob ognju: kukavica iz Borrowdala in zid, Bowder Stone na robu, Gospa jezera in meč kralja Arturja, velikanski kralj Owain in divji prašiči ter hob, ki je zaradi novega plašča odšel.
description.it: Le parole delle storie che il vecchio Wilf racconta la sera accanto al fuoco: il cuculo di Borrowdale e il muro, il Bowder Stone in bilico, la Dama del Lago e la spada di re Artù, Owain il re gigante e i cinghiali, e il folletto che se n'è andato per un cappotto nuovo.
description.de: Die Wörter der Geschichten, die der alte Wilf abends am Feuer erzählt: der Kuckuck von Borrowdale und die Mauer, der Bowder Stone auf der Kante, die Herrin vom See und König Artus' Schwert, Owain der Riesenkönig und die Wildschweine, und der Hob, der wegen eines neuen Mantels ging.

words.example_en: The giant is as tall as a tree.
words.example_it: Il gigante è alto come un albero.
words.example_de: Der Riese ist so groß wie ein Baum.
words.note: Giant can also mean very big: a giant stone, a giant cake.
words.note_sl: Giant pomeni tudi ogromen: a giant stone, a giant cake.
words.note_it: Giant vuol dire anche enorme: a giant stone, a giant cake.
words.note_de: Giant heißt auch riesig: a giant stone, a giant cake.

words.example_en: Wilf sits on a big stone by the fire.
words.example_sl: Wilf sedi na velikem kamnu ob ognju.
words.example_it: Wilf è seduto su una grossa pietra vicino al fuoco.
words.example_de: Wilf sitzt auf einem großen Stein am Feuer.
words.note: Stone is also what a thing is made of: a stone wall, a stone bridge. The British weigh people in stones too: one stone is 14 pounds, about 6 kilos.
words.note_sl: Stone je tudi snov: a stone wall (kamnit zid). Britanci v stonih merijo tudi težo ljudi: en stone je 14 funtov, okoli 6 kilogramov.
words.note_it: Stone è anche il materiale: a stone wall (un muro di pietra). Gli inglesi pesano le persone anche in stone: uno stone è 14 libbre, circa 6 chili.
words.note_de: Stone ist auch das Material: a stone wall (eine Steinmauer). Briten wiegen Menschen auch in stones: ein stone sind 14 englische Pfund, etwa 6 Kilo.

words.example_en: In April the cuckoo comes back to the valley.
words.example_sl: Aprila se kukavica vrne v dolino.
words.example_it: Ad aprile il cuculo torna nella valle.
words.example_de: Im April kommt der Kuckuck ins Tal zurück.
words.note: Spelt c-u-c-k-o-o, and it calls its own name. In Britain its call means that spring is here.
words.note_sl: Piše se c-u-c-k-o-o in kliče svoje ime. V Britaniji njen klic pomeni, da je prišla pomlad.
words.note_it: Si scrive c-u-c-k-o-o e canta il suo nome. In Gran Bretagna il suo verso vuol dire che è arrivata la primavera.
words.note_de: Man schreibt c-u-c-k-o-o, und er ruft seinen eigenen Namen. In Großbritannien heißt sein Ruf: Der Frühling ist da.

words.example_en: The sheep are behind the stone wall.
words.example_it: Le pecore sono dietro il muro di pietra.
words.example_de: Die Schafe sind hinter der Steinmauer.
words.note: One word for a wall outside and the wall of a room. On the fells there are drystone walls: stones with no cement.
words.note_sl: Ena beseda za zid zunaj in steno v sobi: wall. Na gorah so drystone walls, suhi zidovi iz kamnov brez malte.
words.note_it: Una sola parola per il muro fuori e la parete di una stanza: wall. Sui monti ci sono i drystone walls, muri a secco senza malta.
words.note_de: Ein Wort für Mauer und Wand: wall. Auf den Bergen stehen drystone walls, Trockenmauern ohne Mörtel.

words.example_en: In spring the lambs are born.
words.example_it: In primavera nascono gli agnelli.
words.example_de: Im Frühling kommen die Lämmer zur Welt.
words.note: A spring is also a place where water comes out of the ground.
words.note_sl: Spring je tudi izvir, kjer voda priteče iz zemlje.
words.note_it: Spring è anche la sorgente, dove l'acqua esce dalla terra.
words.note_de: Spring ist auch eine Quelle, wo Wasser aus der Erde kommt.

words.example_en: Borrowdale is a green valley.
words.example_it: Borrowdale è una valle verde.
words.example_de: Borrowdale ist ein grünes Tal.
words.note: Plural valleys: after a vowel the y stays (but city, cities). In the Lakes a valley is also a dale: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_sl: Množina valleys: za samoglasnikom y ostane (ampak city, cities). V Jezernem okrožju je dolina tudi dale: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_it: Plurale valleys: dopo una vocale la y resta (ma city, cities). Nel Distretto dei Laghi una valle è anche un dale: Borrowdale, Langdale.
words.note_de: Plural valleys: nach einem Vokal bleibt das y (aber city, cities). Im Lake District heißt ein Tal auch dale: Borrowdale, Langdale.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson plants the potatoes in rows.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson sadi krompir v vrste.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson pianta le patate in file.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson pflanzt die Kartoffeln in Reihen.
words.note: In a row also means one after another: three days in a row. Row rhymes with go.
words.note_sl: In a row pomeni tudi zapored: three days in a row, tri dni zapored. Row se rima z go.
words.note_it: In a row vuol dire anche di fila: three days in a row, tre giorni di fila. Row fa rima con go.
words.note_de: In a row heißt auch hintereinander: three days in a row, drei Tage hintereinander. Row reimt sich auf go.

words.example_en: Alfie climbs up the ladder.
words.example_it: Alfie sale sulla scala a pioli.
words.example_de: Alfie klettert die Leiter hinauf.
words.note: You can carry a ladder; stairs are part of a house.
words.note_sl: Lestev lahko neseš; stopnice v hiši so stairs.
words.note_it: In italiano scala vuol dire due cose: ladder (a pioli, si può portare) e stairs (le scale di casa).
words.note_de: Eine Leiter kann man tragen; eine Treppe im Haus heißt stairs.

words.example_en: In winter there is ice on the tarn.
words.example_sl: Pozimi je na gorskem jezercu led.
words.example_it: D'inverno c'è il ghiaccio sul laghetto di montagna.
words.example_de: Im Winter ist Eis auf dem Bergsee.
words.note: Uncountable: some ice, a lot of ice. What you eat is ice cream. A tarn is a small lake in the fells.
words.note_sl: Neštevno: some ice, a lot of ice. Sladoled je ice cream. Tarn je majhno gorsko jezero.
words.note_it: Non numerabile: some ice, a lot of ice. Il gelato è ice cream. Un tarn è un laghetto di montagna.
words.note_de: Nicht zählbar: some ice, a lot of ice. Eis zum Essen heißt ice cream. Ein tarn ist ein kleiner Bergsee.

words.example_en: King Arthur has a magic sword.
words.example_it: Re Artù ha una spada magica.
words.example_de: König Artus hat ein Zauberschwert.
words.note: The w is silent: sword sounds like 'sord'.
words.note_sl: W se ne izgovori: sword se sliši kot 'sord'.
words.note_it: La w è muta: sword si pronuncia come 'sord'.
words.note_de: Das w ist stumm: sword klingt wie 'sord'.

words.example_en: Derwentwater is a lake near Keswick.
words.example_it: Derwentwater è un lago vicino a Keswick.
words.example_de: Derwentwater ist ein See bei Keswick.
words.note: Most lakes here are called 'water' or 'mere' (Derwentwater, Windermere); only Bassenthwaite Lake has 'Lake' in its name.
words.note_sl: Večina jezer tukaj se imenuje 'water' ali 'mere' (Derwentwater, Windermere); samo Bassenthwaite Lake ima v imenu 'Lake'.
words.note_it: Qui quasi tutti i laghi si chiamano 'water' o 'mere' (Derwentwater, Windermere); solo Bassenthwaite Lake ha 'Lake' nel nome.
words.note_de: Lake ist der See; die See (das Meer) ist the sea. Die meisten Seen hier heißen 'water' oder 'mere'; nur Bassenthwaite Lake hat 'Lake' im Namen.

words.example_en: The king has a gold crown.
words.example_it: Il re ha una corona d'oro.
words.example_de: Der König hat eine goldene Krone.
words.note: Before a name, with a capital letter: King Arthur, King Charles.
words.note_sl: Pred imenom z veliko začetnico: King Arthur, King Charles.
words.note_it: Davanti a un nome, con la maiuscola: King Arthur, King Charles.
words.note_de: Vor einem Namen, groß geschrieben: King Arthur, King Charles.

words.example_en: The knight rides a white horse.
words.example_it: Il cavaliere cavalca un cavallo bianco.
words.example_de: Der Ritter reitet auf einem weißen Pferd.
words.note: The k is silent: knight sounds just like night. A knight is called Sir: Sir Bedivere.
words.note_sl: K se ne izgovori: knight se sliši enako kot night. Vitezu rečejo Sir: Sir Bedivere.
words.note_it: La k è muta: knight si pronuncia come night. Un cavaliere si chiama Sir: Sir Bedivere.
words.note_de: Das k ist stumm: knight klingt genau wie night. Einen Ritter nennt man Sir: Sir Bedivere.

words.example_en: The Lady of the Lake lives under the water.
words.example_it: La Dama del Lago vive sotto l'acqua.
words.example_de: Die Herrin vom See lebt unter dem Wasser.
words.note: Plural ladies: after a consonant, y becomes ies. A polite word for a woman: 'Ladies and gentlemen!'
words.note_sl: Množina ladies: za soglasnikom se y spremeni v ies. Vljudna beseda za žensko: 'Ladies and gentlemen!' (Dame in gospodje!)
words.note_it: Plurale ladies: dopo una consonante la y diventa ies. Parola gentile per una donna: 'Ladies and gentlemen!' (Signore e signori!)
words.note_de: Plural ladies: nach einem Konsonanten wird y zu ies. Ein höfliches Wort für eine Frau: 'Ladies and gentlemen!' (Meine Damen und Herren!)

words.example_en: The Giant's Grave is in Penrith.
words.example_it: La Tomba del Gigante è a Penrith.
words.example_de: Das Riesengrab ist in Penrith.
words.note: A grave is where a person is buried, in a churchyard (round a church) or a graveyard.
words.note_sl: Grob je v churchyard (pokopališče ob cerkvi) ali graveyard (pokopališče).
words.note_it: Attenzione: in inglese grave è la tomba. 'Grave' nel senso di serio si dice serious. Le tombe sono nel churchyard, il cimitero della chiesa.
words.note_de: Gräber sind auf dem churchyard (Kirchhof) oder dem graveyard (Friedhof).

words.example_en: A wild boar lives in the forest.
words.example_it: Nel bosco vive un cinghiale.
words.example_de: Im Wald lebt ein Wildschwein.
words.note: Usually wild boar: a wild pig with tusks. Long ago wild boars lived in England's forests.
words.note_sl: Navadno wild boar: divji prašič z okli. Nekoč so živeli v angleških gozdovih.
words.note_it: Di solito wild boar: il cinghiale, un maiale selvatico con le zanne. Tanto tempo fa viveva nei boschi inglesi.
words.note_de: Meist wild boar: ein Wildschwein mit Hauern. Früher lebten sie in Englands Wäldern.

words.example_en: It's dark in the cave.
words.example_it: Nella grotta è buio.
words.example_de: In der Höhle ist es dunkel.
words.note: A big hole in a hill or under the ground. A place where people cut stone is a quarry.
words.note_sl: Velika luknja v hribu ali pod zemljo. Kamnolom je quarry.
words.note_it: Falso amico: cave è la grotta. La cava di pietra si dice quarry.
words.note_de: Ein großes Loch in einem Berg oder unter der Erde. Ein Steinbruch ist a quarry.

words.example_en: The hob works in the barn at night.
words.example_it: Il folletto hob lavora di notte nel fienile.
words.example_de: Der Hob arbeitet nachts in der Scheune.
words.note: A little hairy helper of old stories from the north of England. In a British kitchen the hob is also the top of the cooker, where the pots go.
words.note_sl: Majhen kosmat pomočnik iz starih zgodb severne Anglije. V britanski kuhinji je hob tudi kuhalna plošča štedilnika.
words.note_it: Un piccolo aiutante peloso delle vecchie storie del nord dell'Inghilterra. In una cucina inglese hob è anche il piano cottura.
words.note_de: Ein kleiner, haariger Helfer aus alten Geschichten Nordenglands. In einer britischen Küche ist hob auch das Kochfeld.

words.example_en: Put your coat on, it's raining!
words.example_it: Mettiti il cappotto, piove!
words.example_de: Zieh deinen Mantel an, es regnet!
words.note: A coat is long and warm; a jacket is shorter. Put on your coat, take off your coat.
words.note_sl: Coat je dolg in topel; jakna je jacket. Put on your coat (obleci plašč), take off your coat (sleci plašč).
words.note_it: Il coat è lungo e caldo; la giacca è jacket. Put on your coat (mettiti il cappotto), take off your coat (togliti il cappotto).
words.note_de: Ein coat ist lang und warm; eine Jacke ist a jacket. Put on your coat (zieh den Mantel an), take off your coat (zieh ihn aus).

words.example_en: Wilf wears an old brown hat.
words.example_it: Wilf porta un vecchio cappello marrone.
words.example_de: Wilf trägt einen alten braunen Hut.
words.note: A woolly hat is a warm knitted one for winter. A cap has a peak at the front.
words.note_sl: Woolly hat je topla pletena kapa za zimo. Cap je kapa s šiltom.
words.note_it: Un woolly hat è un berretto di lana per l'inverno. Un cap ha la visiera.
words.note_de: Ein woolly hat ist eine warme Strickmütze für den Winter. Eine cap hat einen Schirm vorne.

words.example_en: The birds fly over the lake.
words.example_it: Gli uccelli volano sopra il lago.
words.example_de: Die Vögel fliegen über den See.
words.note: Irregular: fly, flew, flown. The cuckoo flew over the wall. (A fly is also a little insect.)
words.note_sl: Nepravilni glagol: fly, flew, flown. The cuckoo flew over the wall. (A fly je tudi muha.)
words.note_it: Verbo irregolare: fly, flew, flown. The cuckoo flew over the wall. (A fly è anche una mosca.)
words.note_de: Unregelmäßig: fly, flew, flown. The cuckoo flew over the wall. (A fly ist auch eine Fliege.)

words.example_en: Harry throws a stone into the tarn.
words.example_sl: Harry vrže kamen v gorsko jezerce.
words.example_it: Harry lancia un sasso nel laghetto di montagna.
words.example_de: Harry wirft einen Stein in den Bergsee.
words.note: Irregular: throw, threw, thrown. Not 'throwed'.
words.note_sl: Nepravilni glagol: throw, threw, thrown. Ne 'throwed'.
words.note_it: Verbo irregolare: throw, threw, thrown. Non 'throwed'.
words.note_de: Unregelmäßig: throw, threw, thrown. Nicht 'throwed'.

words.example_en: The knights fight for the king.
words.example_it: I cavalieri combattono per il re.
words.example_de: Die Ritter kämpfen für den König.
words.note: Irregular: fight, fought, fought. Owain fought the wild boars.
words.note_sl: Nepravilni glagol: fight, fought, fought. Owain fought the wild boars.
words.note_it: Verbo irregolare: fight, fought, fought. Owain fought the wild boars.
words.note_de: Unregelmäßig: fight, fought, fought. Owain fought the wild boars.

words.example_en: Granny Maggie sweeps the kitchen floor.
words.example_it: Nonna Maggie spazza il pavimento della cucina.
words.example_de: Oma Maggie fegt den Küchenboden.
words.note: Irregular: sweep, swept, swept. Not 'sweeped'.
words.note_sl: Nepravilni glagol: sweep, swept, swept. Ne 'sweeped'.
words.note_it: Verbo irregolare: sweep, swept, swept. Non 'sweeped'.
words.note_de: Unregelmäßig: sweep, swept, swept. Nicht 'sweeped'.
